messages:
Ivy: Incident summary: after a hosted master-key rotation a set of private adapters returned 401s for ~20s. Root cause: some sidecars missed the push and then retried aggressively. We need a clear rebind ownership model.

Sam: Short answer: control plane should be authoritative for hosted rotations, but adapters must support an offline-first fallback. Hybrid mode (push by default, signed-lease pull when unreachable) seems pragmatic.

Noah: Signed-lease sketch: CP issues a signed blob containing adapter_id, tenant_id, expiry, nonce, aud. Adapter validates signature locally and exchanges for ephemeral local creds. This lets private installs rotate without CP contact.

Ivy: Ops note: adapters retried and hit CP rate limits. Add client-side exponential backoff + capped jitter. CP should expose tenant-level metrics to detect rebind storms.

SRE-Leah: Metrics & runbook: instrument auth.rebind_attempts, auth.rebind_failures, auth.rebind_backoff_seconds. If failures >5 in 60s mark tenant degraded and route to fallback model; add a CLI to suppress rotations for a tenant.

Sam: Config proposal for adapter: auth_mode: push|pull|hybrid (default hybrid), signed_lease_ttl: 300s, max_rebinds_per_min: 6, local_kms: optional. Default TTL conservative to avoid churn.

Noah: Edge-case: in-flight requests with cached KV entries. Options: make tokens request-scoped or implement a short drain+flush barrier during swap. Document SLO impact.

Ivy: Thundering-herd mitigation: adapters should set header X-Rebind-State: in-progress during swap so proxies can suppress parallel retries. Also telemetry to surface when many adapters rebind simultaneously.

ops-bot: CI: unit tests for adapter rebind passed (8/8), private integration flaky (2/4). https://ci.redwood.example/5901234567 :gear:

Ivy: Action items: Sam/Noah draft RFC contrasting push-first vs pull-first (include signed-lease format and verification, KV-barrier approach, backoff heuristics). SRE-Leah draft metrics+runbook. I'll attach repro logs to the RFC and propose hybrid defaults in config PR.

Sam: Agreed. We'll capture corner cases (tenant-bound leases, replay protection, key-id rotation) in RFC and aim to sync in next arch meeting. :thumbsup:
